description.value: Oceanside Place Arena is a publicly operated multi-sport recreation facility in Parksville, managed by the Regional District of Nanaimo. Situated on the West Island Highway, it serves the Oceanside region as a community hub for indoor sport and recreation. Touring cyclists passing through Parksville may find it a convenient stop given its accessible highway-side location.
